cohort: 100 patients with American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) status class-II, age>=18 and BMI 18-30 kg/m2 who underwent cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Prophylactic use of 4mg intravenous ondansetron 5 minutes before spinal anesthesia significantly reduces the incidence of hypotension, nausea and vomiting in parturient undergoing elective cesarean section.
